May 28, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Aviance Capital Partners Llc increased its stake in Coca (KO) by 41.87% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aviance Capital Partners Llc bought 10,518 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.92% with the market. The institutional investor held 35,640 shares of the beverages (production and distribution) company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.64 million, up from 25,122 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aviance Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Coca for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $180.42B market cap company. The stock increased 0.19% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $42.4. About 8.81M shares traded. The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO) has risen 1.35% since May 28, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.20% the S&P500.
Aureus Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Unifirst Corporation (UNF) by 33.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aureus Asset Management Llc sold 2,200 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.00% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,367 shares of the other consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $720,000, down from 6,567 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aureus Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Unifirst Corporation for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.35 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.31% or $0.55 during the last trading session, reaching $175.2. About 43,484 shares traded. UniFirst Corporation (NYSE:UNF) has risen 7.02% since May 28, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.53% the S&P500.
